text:
Elaine: AM async — quick standup: audits/vuln sweep + KMS rotation dry-run. What I did: finished audit findings list for acct-prod, filed quick remediations for 3 low-risk perms. Blockers: need review on PR #482 (iam: scoped role changes) from @Sam. Today: run rotation dry-run on staging, confirm key aliases + rotation window.

Sam: acked PR #482, leaving comments now. FYI I saw one service principal with broad iam:PassRole in audit — flagged in the PR. Will push a follow-up to lock that down.

Maria: re: vuln remediation — snyk alerted on 2 deps in the kube-controller image. Spun a patch image and ran local bench. No failures so far. Pushing to canary later today.

Tony: ops-bot reported KMS rotation dry-run succeeded for vault-key-2 but failed for legacy-key-1 due to missing alias. I can add alias if we agree on name `alias/redwood/legacy-key-1`. pinging infra-owner @Elaine for final okay.

ops-bot: [auto] KMS rotation dry-run results: vault-key-2: SUCCESS, legacy-key-1: ERROR (missing alias). See logs: <https://logs.internal/runs/1777777123|run-1777777123>

Elaine: +1 to alias name. Tony please add alias and re-run. Also @Sam can you include the PassRole fix in the same PR if it's small? would reduce churn.

Sam: yes, can do. Will also add a short test to assert no broad PassRole in staging service accounts. PR now: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/482|#482>

Maria: canary deploy scheduled for 12:30 PT. I'll monitor AppErrors and alert if regressions >0.5% for 15m window.

Tony: alias added, re-run queued. ETA ~10m. I also opened a tiny infra task to document alias naming: INFRA-563.

Elaine: sweet. Blockers cleared for me except waiting on canary metrics. If nothing flares, I'll schedule prod rotation for 2026-03-18 03:00 UTC (low-traffic). If anyone objects, say now.

Sam: no objections from SRE side.

Maria: sounds good from my side.

Tony: fine with that. I'll be on-call during the window.

Elaine: thanks all — will post follow-up here after prod rotation. :thumbsup:
